# Appeal of Adverse Benefit Determination

**RE: Appeal of Denied Prior Authorization — Total Shoulder Replacement (CPT 23472)**
**Member:** Riley Novak
**Member ID:** W755986580
**Plan:** Molina Healthcare (Commercial/ACA), Mississippi
**Denial date:** 2026-08-10
**Reference number:** POC-1EC0B0CD1F-92337

Dear Molina Healthcare Appeals Department,

I am writing to request reconsideration of the denial of my prior authorization request for a total shoulder replacement (CPT 23472). My surgeon, Dr. Duval, has documented that this procedure is medically necessary, and I am asking Molina to review the clinical evidence again.

**Governing policy:** No specific Molina medical policy or clinical criteria document was cited by name in my denial notice, and none has been provided to me. I address this in the section below.

## Why I believe this decision should be reconsidered

My denial states that "the imaging findings submitted do not support the medical necessity of the requested procedure." I do not believe this reflects the full record. My chart includes the following, which I ask Molina to review again:

- **Imaging:** An MRI of my shoulder dated 2026-07-14 shows a full-thickness supraspinatus tear measuring 1.8 cm with grade 2 fatty atrophy.
- **Duration and severity of symptoms:** I have had 12 months of progressive shoulder pain that does not improve with rest.
- **Functional limitation:** I cannot lift my arm above shoulder height, and I cannot sleep on the affected side.
- **Exam findings:** My physical exam showed positive provocative testing on the affected shoulder and pain-limited range of motion.
- **Conservative treatment already tried:** I completed 16 weeks of supervised physical therapy (16 visits, from 2026-03-06 to 2026-06-26) focused on rotator cuff strengthening and scapular mechanics, as documented in my physical therapy discharge note. I also took NSAIDs for 6 months without adequate relief, and I received a corticosteroid injection on 2026-03-29, which gave only 4 weeks of partial relief.
- **No disqualifying factors noted in my chart:** No active infection, no untreated substance use, a BMI of 29, and I am a non-smoker.

Taken together, this record documents a confirmed structural tear on imaging, a year of unresolved symptoms, failed conservative treatment, and significant functional impairment. I am not aware of any specific imaging or clinical criteria in the denial notice that my records fail to meet — because no such criteria were quoted or provided to me. I am asking Molina to identify, in writing, exactly which imaging finding or clinical requirement it believes is missing from my file.

## Request for the criteria applied to my case

Molina's own utilization management materials state that clinical review criteria (MCG) are available to providers through the secure provider portal, and that members may call to request the criteria used in a final determination. I am formally requesting, in writing, **the MCG guideline title and the specific criteria applied to my determination**, so that I and my surgeon can review it directly and respond point by point if any element still appears unmet.

## What I am asking Molina to do

1. Reconsider the denial of CPT 23472 (total shoulder replacement) in light of the clinical documentation summarized above.
2. Provide, in writing, the specific MCG guideline title and criteria used to deny this request.
3. Confirm receipt of this appeal and let me know if any additional records are needed.

I understand my appeal must be received by 2027-02-06, though I ask Molina to confirm this deadline against the date on my denial letter, which is authoritative. I am submitting this appeal to the address printed on my denial notice, and I am also available through the Molina member portal at molinahealthcare.com or by phone at the Member Services number on my ID card.

Thank you for reviewing my case again. Please contact me if any further information is needed.

Sincerely,

________________________________
Riley Novak
Member ID: W755986580
[Address]
[Phone number]
[Email address]
Date: [date of submission]

**Enclosures:** [Physical therapy discharge note, MRI report dated 2026-07-14, surgeon's letter of medical necessity, other supporting records as applicable]
